strings.ADD_LEDE: Description and amount are typed — everything else is a chip, because it is a choice from a set.
strings.ADJUSTED_NEGATIVE: An adjustment takes someone below nothing.
strings.ADJUSTED_OVER: The adjustments come to more than the total.
strings.ALL_SETTLED: Everyone is level · the ledger keeps every expense that got you here
strings.ARCHIVED_META: archived · out of the lists, everything kept
strings.ARCHIVE_BODY: It leaves the lists and keeps everything.
strings.ARCHIVE_BODY_2: Archiving is not deleting, and it does not need a settled balance.
strings.BALANCES_STATUS: Every figure is derived at read time · no balance is stored
strings.CURRENCY_NOTE: The rate is supplied at entry, with its source and date.
strings.CURRENCY_NOTE_2: There is no rate provider, and the vault works with none.
strings.CURRENCY_UNKNOWN: Centraid does not know this money’s decimal places yet.
strings.DAY_ONE_SUB: The first real move is one expense with one person; a group can wait for three of you.
strings.DELETE_GROUP_BODY: A group with expenses on it cannot be deleted — an empty one goes for good.
strings.DENIED_BODY: Your expenses, groups and receipts are untouched, and nothing was deleted.
strings.DENIED_REGRANT: Re-grant tally.read and tally.write to see them again.
strings.DEPARTED_META: departed · kept on the ledger with the balance they left
strings.DISCARD_BODY: What you typed here is not saved.
strings.EXPENSE_GONE_BODY: It was purged from the trash, or never reached this vault.
strings.EXPORT_FOOT: The file leaves the vault the moment you save it
strings.EXPORT_FORMAT_VALUE: CSV · one row per expense and settlement
strings.EXPORT_LEDE: Every expense, split, settlement and revision in the group, as a file on this device.
strings.EXPORT_NOTE: The file carries splits and revisions, not balances — balances are arithmetic, and arithmetic travels in the rows.
strings.FRIEND_BODY: A friend is a person in People — adding one writes there, and every app knows the same person.
strings.FRIEND_GONE: This person is not on the ledger.
strings.FRIEND_GONE_BODY: They may have been removed from your friends.
strings.FRIEND_HERO_SUB: Every part of it is a fact, and each one opens.
strings.FRIEND_PARTS_NOTE: The net above is these parts added up · each one is derived from the same facts
strings.GROUPS_EMPTY_BODY: A group can wait until there are three of you.
strings.GROUP_BODY: A group needs a name, an icon and a colour, and you are a member from the start.
strings.GROUP_GONE_BODY: It was deleted, and its ledger with it.
strings.GROUP_HERO_OWED: owed to you in this group
strings.GROUP_HERO_SUB: Derived from the group’s expenses and settlements, and never stored.
strings.GROUP_LEDGER_EMPTY: No expenses in this group yet.
strings.HERO_SETTLED_SUB: Every group and every friend is level, and the ledger keeps all of it.
strings.IOU_META: a standing obligation · Tally reads it and never writes it
strings.LEAVE_BODY: Your rows stay on the ledger, marked departed, and your balance with the group stays visible.
strings.LEFT_TO_DIVIDE: The amounts do not reach the total yet.
strings.LINES_OVER: The lines come to more than the total.
strings.LINES_SHORT: The lines do not reach the total yet.
strings.MATCH_ACCEPTED: Recorded as one movement, and both lines stay.
strings.MATCH_REJECTED: Recorded as two payments, and both lines stay.
strings.MEMBER_BODY: Only a person in People can join a group; add them as a friend first.
strings.MEMBER_NONE: Everyone you know is already in this group.
strings.MORE_FOOT: Lenses and acts · the four places are in the band
strings.NO_LINES: Add the lines it is made of.
strings.NUDGE_BODY: The reminder is recorded as your intention, and it waits for you to confirm it.
strings.ON_THE_LEDGER: on the ledger · cannot be removed
strings.OVER_THE_TOTAL: The amounts come to more than the total.
strings.PAYMENT_OVER: That is more than is owed.
strings.PURGE_UNKNOWN: purges 30 days after it was trashed
strings.RATE_REMEMBERED: the rate this vault was given
strings.RATE_SUGGESTION_NOTE: A rate this vault was already given for the same pair · press to fill it in
strings.READS_FACT_READS_VALUE: Expenses, settlements, groups and the people in them
strings.READS_FACT_STORED_VALUE: No balance · every figure is worked out when you look
strings.READ_INCOMPLETE: Tally could not read all of this. Try again.
strings.RECEIPT_LEDE_ORIGIN: Photographed at the table, and reviewed in the capture flow — what happens here is who had what.
strings.RECEIPT_NONE: This expense has no receipt — capture belongs to the phone.
strings.RECEIPT_SHOT_ABSENT: the photograph · a document in the vault
strings.RECURRING_EMPTY_BODY: A repeating expense is set up once, and its schedule is said in a sentence.
strings.REFUSED: Refused · the vault would not take it
strings.REMOVE_BODY: They hold no rows here, so the ledger reads the same without them.
strings.RULE_ADJUSTED: An equal base, then each adjustment moves a part up or down.
strings.RULE_BY_LINE: Typed lines that make the total, each shared by its people.
strings.RULE_EQUALLY: The odd penny goes to the payer, always.
strings.RULE_EXACT: The amounts add up to the total exactly.
strings.RULE_PERCENTAGES: They total 100 · it will not save at 99.
strings.RULE_SHARES: Weights, as a recurring template splits.
strings.SEARCH_NOT_SEARCHED: Amounts and people are not searched.
strings.SETTLEMENT_NOT_YOURS: neither party is you · no ledger entry, balances only
strings.SETTLE_FOOT_THEIRS: neither party is you · no ledger entry, balances only
strings.SETTLE_FOOT_YOURS: A payment where you are a party also lands in the finance ledger, as a core transaction
strings.SETTLE_LEDE: A settlement records a payment that happened. Nothing moves money; there is no payment rail in this product.
strings.SIMPLIFICATION: Five debts become three payments. Simplification rewires who owes whom, so it is off unless a group turns it on, and it says what it changed.
strings.SIMPLIFY_EXPLAINED: Simplification rewires who owes whom, so it is off unless a group turns it on, and it says what it changed.
strings.SIMPLIFY_NONE: Nothing to rewire · this group is already level
strings.SIMPLIFY_OFF: Off for this group · debts read as they were incurred
strings.SIMPLIFY_ON: On for this group · the proposal is below
strings.SPENDING_CURRENCIES_NOTE: Each money is its own total; none is added to another.
strings.SPEND_DIFFERENCE_NOTE: carried in balances, never a saving
strings.TEMPLATE_LEDE: A template splits by weight, so a share can be two parts to one without a percentage.
strings.TEMPLATE_UNSAVEABLE: This template is missing fields the save command requires, so its acts are withheld
strings.TRASH_BODY: It goes to the trash for 30 days and comes back whole, with its splits and revisions.
strings.UNARCHIVE_BODY: It returns to the lists with everything it kept.
strings.UNSUMMARISABLE: This one’s schedule cannot be put in a sentence, so there is no preview.
strings.WINDOW_FILLED: Figures are over the latest 2,000 expenses
